280703624.description:
Natural Stone Rock Collection Lot
Mineral Specimen Set, 3 Pieces
Various Earth Tones
A collection of three distinct natural rock specimens featuring a variety of textures and earth-toned colors. These pieces represent different geological formations, displaying characteristic weathering, layering, and mineral compositions. Such sets are ideal for educational study, garden accents, or as part of a natural history display collection.
Items Included:
Tan/Brown Specimen - Layered metamorphic or sedimentary rock with a flat profile and textured surface.
Grey Specimen - Porous, vesicular texture with a blocky, rounded shape and light grey coloration.
Reddish-Brown Specimen - Dense rock with iron-rich hues and visible mineral grains, displaying a rugged rectangular form.
Condition:
Natural state with expected geological variations. Surfaces show authentic weathering, pits, and mineral deposits consistent with natural formation. No artificial polishing or modifications observed. Edges are naturally irregular. Overall solid structural integrity for each piece.
Thank you for all of your support!
